//: OVERLAY SWEEP FINDINGS BASELINE — read e2e/happy-path/overlay-sweep.spec.ts first.
Each key is `route :: overlay role :: rule class`. A finding whose key is NOT
here fails the sweep. That direction is strict and sound: a finding is derived
from the DOM the app actually rendered, so the prober's nondeterminism can only
ever hide a finding, never invent one.
The other direction — 'this no longer reproduces, delete it' — is deliberately
NOT asserted, and the spec's header records why with the measurements. What IS
asserted is that every key names a route the sweep still probes.
This is NOT a place to put a finding you have not looked at. Every entry below
was traced to a source line before it was written down; six findings were FIXED
instead of recorded, and one whole class turned out to be a defect in the CHECK.
FIVE FULL RUNS, 2026-09-21 (~22 min each, 66 routes, 79-86 overlay opens).
Run 1 produced 9 distinct keys. Disposition of every one:
6 x no-accessible-name — REAL, FIXED, not baselined. Six Radix PopoverContents
rendered role="dialog" with no name, so a screen reader announced each as
bare "dialog": ReviewsTab (sort), SavedHelpersTab (filter, sort),
JobActionRow (job overflow actions), RecognitionRow (+N-more badges),
ProfileBadge (per-badge explainer). ReviewsTab's OTHER popover already
carried an aria-label with a comment explaining exactly this, so the
convention existed and these six had simply missed it.
1 x background-not-scroll-locked — NOT a defect; a defect in the CHECK, now
fixed. It keyed on role="dialog", which Radix also gives a NON-modal
Popover, and a popover is supposed to leave the page behind scrollable.
The rule keys on aria-modal="true" now.
3 x axe:color-contrast — REAL, and none of them ours to fix: both colours
resolve out of src/index.css, which is orchestrator-owned. Filed for the
design/a11y lane. Details on each key below.
CORRECTION, 2026-09-21. The first version of this file said #83837c came from
--muted-foreground via --stormy-sky and concluded that every text-muted-foreground
on white fails AA. THAT WAS WRONG, and wrong in a way worth naming: the ratio came
from axe and the token was then inferred BY EYE from a grep of index.css. It is not
a token at all — --stormy-sky is #516067, 6.52:1 on white, which passes.
Read off the computed style at the failing node instead (the method that should
have been used first), it is a COMPOSITE, and component-level:
span.ml-1.5.text-ds-11.font-normal.tabular-nums.opacity-70   text '5:00 PM'
color    rgba(46, 47, 34, 0.85)     ink at 85% alpha
opacity  0.7                        stacked on top of that alpha
behind   .segmented-track rgba(255,255,255,0.5) over .bg-popover #ffffff
46,47,34 at 0.85 over white = rgb(77,78,67); that at opacity 0.7 over white
= rgb(130,131,123) = #82837b. axe says #83837c — one unit, rounding. Confirmed.
So the defect is an opacity-70 stacked on an already-85%-alpha ink colour at 11px
inside TimeRangeField's segmented control. Do NOT repaint --muted-foreground on
the strength of this finding.

keys./posts :: dialog :: axe:color-contrast: The SOS / emergency dialog: #fdfdfd on #b95e35 = 4.37:1 against a 4.5:1 floor (WCAG 2 AA 1.4.3, axe impact serious). Marginal but real, and on the control where a user is least able to cope with hard-to-read text. CAUSE NOT YET ESTABLISHED: #b95e35 is not --destructive (#b14a1b light / #c3521d dark), so it is most likely a composite too — but the trigger could not be reached on demand to read the computed style (/posts is the volatile route; see the spec header). Take the computed value at the node before attributing it to any token.
keys./profile?tab=availability :: dialog :: a: TimeRangeField popover, trigger "9 AM - 5 PM": #83837c on #ffffff = 3.81:1, needs 4.5:1 (WCAG 2 AA 1.4.3, axe impact serious). COMPOSITE, not a token — see the correction above. The failing node is the 11px time span: rgba(46,47,34,0.85) under a further opacity-70, over the popover's white. Fixing it is a component change in src/components/TimeRangeField.tsx, and it is a VISUAL change, so it needs the owner's screenshot-before-and-after rule rather than a blind edit from this lane. (Was also keyed under the /availability alias until that route was deleted, Q194 2026-09-23.)
